owner_calls.question: Where does The Avengers' Project Pegasus base (entry 2, sub 'Project Pegasus') sit: New Mexico, or the Mojave Desert with Captain Marvel's Pegasus facility?
options: Keep it in New Mexico (the film never names the state; the Phase One tie-in book and the Albuquerque shoot say New Mexico)
Move the entry to 'mojave|earth|' as the same Joint Dark Energy Mission Facility seen in Captain Marvel
owner_calls.evidence: The MCU wiki's Joint Dark Energy Mission Facility page treats The Avengers base and Captain Marvel's Pegasus facility as one place and puts it in the Mojave Desert. Its own notes say the Phase One: Marvel's The Avengers book puts it in New Mexico, and the scenes were shot in Albuquerque. The Avengers itself doesn't name the state on screen.
